doc.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024

title: Closing pleasantries and the pronunciation of Neves
summary: Friesen compliments Rowe's questions; they discuss Neves, 'seven' backwards, and the ear-friendly orchestrated version.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview
